title: Backend responses hide the record owner from unrelated readers
why: Anonymous and unrelated readers no longer receive the `owner` id; client code that showed or compared it gets undefined.
changelog: Backend responses no longer include the record `owner` id
steps: For each listed read of `.owner`, confirm the reader is the owner, a relational owner or a role in the read policy.
If the owner id must stay public, declare `expose_owner: true` in that resource's query.jsbrain.
